item.title: Botanic Gardens hosts winter Light Show
item.description: Despite recent drops in temperature, the Wellesley College Botanic Gardens Light Show offered a warm and welcoming retreat for visitors on Jan. 28 and 29. Featuring interactive activities such as watercolor painting, tea making and microscopy, the annual event centered the theme of water, the sustaining resource shared by both plants and humans.
